title: 교육감 소속 지방공무원 인사교류 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 8 (Surveys of Demand for Personnel Exchanges, etc.)
(1) The Minister of Education may periodically survey demand for personnel exchanges in order to prepare personnel exchange plans under Article 7 (1). <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(2) Where a superintendent of a district office of education or a superintendent of education deems a personnel exchange necessary, such person may request the exchange from the superintendent of education or the Minister of Education, respectively. In such cases, a superintendent of education shall consolidate and coordinate demand for personnel exchanges within the competent City/Do and make a request to the Minister of Education. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
